versions.changelog:
- Added explicit mention that product data is sourced from Rainforest API, an authorized Amazon product data provider.
- Updated permissions to clarify buystuff.ai's use of Rainforest API for search and product detail data.
- No functional or API changes; update improves transparency about data sourcing and security.

- Clarified that the skill cannot charge money or complete purchases; it only sends a payment link via email and the user must pay separately on buystuff.ai  
- Updated data handling and email usage sections for clearer messaging on privacy and approval  
- Revised payment flow description: "request payment link" replaces "confirm order" to highlight user control  
- Strengthened user safety and confirmation language: agents must get explicit approval before sending a payment link  
- No functional or API changes; documentation is now clearer and more accurate about payment and order flow

- Clarified data handling to specify shipping details are only shared with Amazon for fulfillment; no other third parties receive user data.
- Updated descriptions for email address and agentId in the data_sent section to reinforce privacy and limited sharing.
- Made minor language improvements for accuracy in the data-handling and privacy sections.

- Expanded the skill and API description for clarity on e-commerce shopping and agent API usage.
- Added more tags for discoverability (e.g., amazon.com, ecommerce, product-search, online-shopping).
- Improved the initial description to mention "Amazon.com" and its API functionality for AI agents.
- No functional or API changes; documentation and discoverability improvements only.

**Multi-item cart and session support added.**

- Added support for session management using `sessionId`/`X-Session-ID` to group actions into a shopping session.
- Users can now add multiple items to a single cart within a session.
- Cart management endpoints and examples included: view cart, update quantity, and remove items.
- Revised step-by-step instructions to reflect session and multi-item cart usage.
- Clarified that each session maintains a single active cart until checkout.

**Major update: Added email-based payment, new data/privacy section, and clarified usage steps.**

- Users now pay via a secure email payment link from buystuff.ai (no payment handled in API or by the agent).
- Email address is now required at checkout for sending payment link and order updates.
- Expanded privacy/data handling section — explains all data fields, destinations, and purposes.
- New section clearly lists when and how to activate the skill.
- Step-by-step instructions updated for clarity, especially about confirmation and data gathering.
- Environment variable BUYSTUFF_AGENT_ID added (optional) for agent order tracking.
- Explicit reminder: always require user confirmation before finalizing any order.

Initial release of Buy Amazon skill.  
- Search Amazon for products, compare prices and ratings, and order to any US address.
- No Amazon account required.
- Step-by-step purchase flow: product search, detail view, cart, checkout, and order confirmation.
- Clearly displays product info, price breakdown (including 10% service fee), and shipping options (with support for Prime/free shipping).
- Supports product variants (color, size) and lets users pick before checkout.
- Built-in order tracking; get updates on order status from placement to delivery.
